نتراضى (form VI)
# نَتَرَاضَى (natarāḍā) /na.ta.raː.dˤaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# نُتَرَاضَى (nutarāḍā) /nu.ta.raː.dˤaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
